race.comment: They'll do well to beat CAVILL AVENUE (1) off her last start performance in the G3 Thoroughbred Club Stakes. She was awesome on the Lakeside track behind top filly Natural Fling, getting a mile back there but ripping home in the best closing splits of the day. Up to 1400m on the bigger track is ideal and she handled soft ground well there. LAFARNA (6) is a nice filly for the Blackiston camp. She had a big hype on her prior to her Geelong debut which saw her jump $1.75 and prove far too strong. Should continue to progress. SOUND BYTE (4) defeated SUNBLISS (5) last start on the Lakeside track in what was a messy race. SOUND BYTE missed the start and nearly fell so it's hard to take anything away from her. SUNBLISS was unlucky in the straight though - there's not much between them. OCEANS BLUE (7) was dominant winner her maiden last time and should measure up.
